verdict.rationale: Gladia documents a live STT quickstart. An init call returns a connectable URL and session id that clients use to stream, the session supports reconnects, and partial and final transcripts arrive in real time. Live-specific settings such as silence thresholds and utterance duration are also documented. Missing for 10: explicit naming of the WebSocket protocol and its message/audio-format details, latency figures, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream live audio over a documented WebSocket or streaming endpoint and receive transcription in real time

citations.quote: We offer a simple API to get transcription from your audios and videos, in both Real-time and asynchronous ways
The init call returns a connectable URL and a session `id` that you can safely pass to web, iOS, or Android clients without exposing credentials
Partial transcripts are provisional; final transcripts complete an utterance.
Configure silence thresholds and maximum utterance duration in Gladia live transcription.
